title: Sales Transaction
description: Adapted sales transaction schema derived from the UCI Online Retail dataset.

invoice_no.description: Invoice or transaction identifier. Values beginning with C represent cancellations in the source dataset.

stock_code.description: Product identifier preserved from the source dataset.

description.description: Product description from the source dataset.

quantity.description: Number of units in the transaction line.

invoice_date.description: Date and time when the invoice was created.

unit_price.description: Unit price recorded on the transaction line.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier preserved from the UCI CustomerID field.

country.description: Country value in the adapted source.

currency.description: Currency used by the adapted Philippine source.

sales_channel.description: Synthetic sales channel assigned during adaptation.

payment_method.description: Synthetic payment method assigned during adaptation.

line_total.description: Derived transaction line amount calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price.

store_id.description: Synthetic store identifier assigned at invoice level.
